visual.general_description: Horizontal timeline of four consecutive colored chevrons labelled Day 0, Day 3, Day 10 and Day 40, each with a text box above and a text box below joined by thin vertical arrows.
visual.detailed_description: Four chevrons run left to right: dark blue labelled Day 0, light blue labelled Day 3, green labelled Day 10 and yellow-orange labelled Day 40. Above each chevron a boxed label is joined to it by an upward arrow: above Day 0 "Normal liver function tests without cholestasis"; above Day 3 "Development of ceftriaxone-induced acute cholestatic hepatitis"; above Day 10 "Significant reduction of transaminases and cholestatic indexes"; above Day 40 "Complete normalization of of transaminases and cholestatic indexes" (the word of is printed twice). Below each chevron a boxed label is joined by a downward arrow: below Day 0 "Admission to pediatric emergency department for laterocervical linfadenitis" and, as a separate paragraph in the same box, "Start of Ceftriaxone therapy"; below Day 3 "Discontinuation of Ceftriaxone therapy"; below Day 10 "The patient was discharged"; below Day 40 "Last follow-up". Wording and spelling are as printed. No numeric laboratory values, axes, scale bars, patient identifiers, dates or institution names are visible.

evidence.quote: Based on these findings, a diagnosis of ceftriaxone-induced hepatitis was performed, and the antibiotic was therefore immediately suspended without replacing it with other antibiotics.
Broad-spectrum intravenous antibiotic treatment with ceftriaxone (75 mg/kg/day) was started with rapid clinical improvement of the later cervical lymphadenitis.
